California

California's C-46 Solar Contractor classification is dedicated and well established, shown here with real license status (Active/Suspended/flagged) from CSLB's own records — including a small number of businesses added after being found licensed under a related classification (C-10 Electrical or B General Building) instead of C-46 itself, the same gap found and fixed for Arizona and Florida. Complaint- and case-level disciplinary detail has not yet been loaded for California; the status shown is CSLB's own license standing, not a complaint history.
